subject.title: fix(memory-wiki): skip malformed legacy import-run files in doctor

question: Should malformed legacy import-run files remain untouched with repeat warnings, or should doctor quarantine them after preserving their contents?
rationale: Both policies avoid silent data loss, but they create different upgrade and operator-recovery behavior that the code history does not conclusively settle.

options.title: Retain and warn
options.body: Keep malformed files at their original paths for manual recovery, while ensuring genuine filesystem failures still abort the migration.

options.title: Quarantine rejected files
options.body: Move malformed files to an explicit recovery location after validation and document how operators can inspect or restore them.

recommendation.title: Retain and warn
recommendation.body: Keep malformed files at their original paths for manual recovery, while ensuring genuine filesystem failures still abort the migration.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the SQLite migration and are best positioned to confirm the intended legacy-file retention contract.
